scenes.narration: ~Hear that? Three in the morning. The whispering is coming from the vents again.
scenes.visual: close on a floor vent in the dark, breath of air, HEAR THAT?

scenes.narration: Two weeks ago you rented this old farmhouse for the winter. Cheap. Way too cheap. Just you... and Moose.
scenes.visual: farmhouse alone in the snow, one window lit

scenes.narration: Moose is a fourteen-year-old hound. Slow. Gentle. Afraid of nothing.
The first night, you heard it. A whisper. Too soft to understand.
scenes.visual: bedroom at night, you sit up in bed

scenes.narration: The second night it was louder. It came from under the floor. From the basement.
scenes.visual: floorboards, the basement door at the end of the hall

scenes.narration: Moose stood at the top of the basement stairs... and growled. He has never growled at anything.
scenes.visual: dog at the top of dark stairs, hackles up

scenes.narration: Then the snow came. Three feet of it. The road disappeared. You're not going anywhere.
scenes.visual: snow piling against the house and the windows

scenes.narration: You started waking up with headaches. Every morning. A little worse every day.
scenes.visual: you at the sink, pills, mirror

scenes.narration: And last night... the whisper said your name. In your mother's voice.
Your mother has been gone for six years.
scenes.visual: an old framed photo on a shelf

scenes.narration: Moose won't eat. He won't get up. He just stares... at the basement door.
scenes.visual: dog lying down staring at a door

scenes.narration: And tonight... the basement door... is open.
scenes.visual: the basement door creaks open into blackness

scenes.narration: Hear that? Tell me in the comments... part two is up next.
